bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
TARGET="2ab0cea0b720e5d7c8e3cd231b8018e2362419f1"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/tumblr-bridge-live-20261114"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$TARGET"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.worktrees"
if test -e "$WT/.git"; then
  test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
else
  test ! -e "$WT"
  git worktree add --detach "$WT" "$TARGET"
fi
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
KEY="$HOME/.config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,secrets
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token"
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True,mode=0o700)
if not p.exists():
    fd=os.open(p,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY,0o600)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as stream:
            stream.write(secrets.token_urlsafe(40))
    except BaseException:
        p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
assert p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size>=32
assert p.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0
PY
test -f "$ROOT/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt"
test -f "$ROOT/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt"
test -e "$WT/deploy/secrets" || ln -s "$ROOT/deploy/secrets" "$WT/deploy/secrets"
docker compose -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy config -q
docker build --pull=false --file "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" --tag "gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate" "$WT" >/dev/null
docker image inspect "gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate" >/dev/null
printf 'BRIDGE_CANDIDATE_BUILT=%s\n' "$TARGET"
